contentHtml:
New Delhi: Philips has partnered with Cent to advance preventive diagnostics and early risk detection in India. The strategic collaboration brings together Philips’ advanced imaging innovations and Cent's preventive health screening mode and aims to explore new approaches to identifying health risks earlier and supporting a more proactive approach to healthcare, the healthtech firm said.

As part of the collaboration, Philips will deploy its helium-free, wide-bore 70 cm 1.5T MRI systems equipped with AI-enabled SmartSpeed image acceleration at Cent preventive health screening centres. “The collaboration is intended to support enhanced screening experience for individuals, high-quality imaging and more efficient MRI workflows, while enabling the evaluation of neurological, spine and oncology-related indications and risk assessment pathways,” a statement said.

Advt

Bharath Sesha, Managing Director, Philips Indian Subcontinent, said, "Advanced imaging technologies and AI-enabled solutions have the potential to support earlier identification of health risks, improve diagnostic confidence and enhance patient experiences. Through our collaboration with Cent, we look forward to exploring innovative approaches that can help strengthen preventive diagnostics and support better health outcomes for more people."
